description: Uva Provincial Council - Order to Appoint Mr. H. P. A. G. Anuruddha and Mr. R. M. Dayarathna to perform the Duties of Secretaries under the Uva Province Provincial Council
categorisation: This gazette contains specific personnel appointments (Mr. H. P. A. G. Anuruddha and Mr. R. M. Dayarathne) with their basic titles (Grade III officer, Class III officer) and the positions they are temporarily assigned to (Secretary to the Ministry, Deputy Chief Secretary). However, it does not include detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas. The content focuses solely on government personnel changes without outlining specific ministerial portfolios or areas of responsibility, making it a People Gazette.
